svg.text: Decomposing any signal into its pure frequency components
Each spike = one pure frequency component
③ SIGNAL DECOMPOSITION — f(t) = Σ Aₙ · sin(nωt + φₙ)
e^(-iωt) wraps f(t) around the circle
Phase tells us the shift of each sine wave.
Duality: F(t) ↔ f(-ω) in freq domain
🎵 Audio EQ, MP3 compression, noise removal
⚡ FFT: O(N log N) fast algorithm
signal from the time domain to the
